meta.name: art-pipeline
meta.description: Manage game art assets from creation to in-engine. Use when organizing sprites, choosing art tools, setting up folder structures, managing source files, or planning asset production. For a solo dev learning art — practical pipeline, not art instruction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搭建游戏美术资产管线,从创建到引擎内
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你在独立开发游戏,想理清美术素材的管理流程。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a game art asset pipeline from source to engine
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a solo dev who wants to manage game art assets efficiently.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按既定流程帮你管理游戏美术资产:检查并搭建 assets/ 与 art-source/ 镜像文件夹结构、纠正不符合规范的文件命名(如 Player Idle (2).png → player_idle_02.png)、提示源文件与导出文件的纪律(不直接改导出文件),并在规划美术任务时参考生产规模估算表给出时间估计,必要时建议调用 scope-guardian 做范围检查。
howto.when: 当你组织精灵、选择美术工具、搭建文件夹结构等涉及美术资产生产与管理的时候触发。

say.text: 一个 32x32 的带动画角色精灵,新手要做多久?
say.note: 会参考生产规模表给出时间估计。

say.text: 画像素画该用哪个工具?
say.note: 会推荐 Aseprite 或 LibreSprite 等。

howto.what_en: Applies the art pipeline: mirrors assets/ and art-source/ folders, fixes filenames (e.g. Player Idle (2).png → player_idle_02.png), enforces source/export discipline, estimates art tasks via the sizing table, calls scope-guardian if needed.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user organizes sprites, chooses art tools, sets up folder structures, or otherwise manages art asset production/planning.

say_en.text: Organize these art files with proper naming and create mirrored assets/ and art-source/ folders.
say_en.note: Will rename files and create the folder structure.

say_en.text: How long does a 32x32 animated character sprite take for a beginner?
say_en.note: Will estimate using the production sizing table.

say_en.text: Which tool should I use for pixel art?
